document_data.title: Pre-Authorization Letter for Lumbar Discectomy
document_data.content:
To Whom It May Concern,

This letter is to summarize the imaging findings for Noah Kim, who has been referred for a lumbar discectomy. 

The MRI of the lumbar spine performed on 2026-08-14 indicates a large left paracentral L5-S1 herniated disc with compression of the left S1 nerve root. This finding demonstrates the significant cause of the patient's low back pain and left radiculopathy.

Given the persistent symptoms and the imaging findings, it is medically necessary for the patient to undergo the surgical procedure for proper management of his condition. We request your consideration for pre-authorization of this necessary procedure.

Sincerely,
Dr. Rivera
